description: The stable CANOPY_* error codes of the wire protocol and REST Problem Details: the one source both languages are checked against.

codes.name: Unauthorized
codes.title: Unauthorized
codes.description: The caller is not authenticated.
codes.hint: Send an API key in the apikey header, and a signed in user's token as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

codes.name: TokenExpired
codes.title: Token expired
codes.description: The access token has expired.
codes.hint: Refresh the access token and retry; the SDK does this itself when it is given a token provider.

codes.name: Forbidden
codes.title: Forbidden
codes.description: No policy grants the operation.
codes.hint: No policy grants this operation to the caller's roles: add an allow rule, or check the roles in the token.

codes.name: NotFound
codes.title: Not found
codes.description: The document does not exist or is not visible.
codes.hint: The document does not exist, or no read policy lets the caller see it.

codes.name: PolicyViolation
codes.title: Policy violation
codes.description: A write failed a policy clause.
codes.hint: The write failed a policy's where or check clause, or touched a field the caller may not write.

codes.name: InvalidQuery
codes.title: Invalid query
codes.description: The query, filter or value is not valid.
codes.hint: Check the operators, field paths and value types; operators Canopy does not support are refused.

codes.name: Conflict
codes.title: Conflict
codes.description: The document changed since it was read.
codes.hint: The document changed since it was read: read it again and retry the write.

codes.name: DuplicateKey
codes.title: Duplicate key
codes.description: A unique index refused the write.

codes.name: PayloadTooLarge
codes.title: Payload too large
codes.description: The request body is too large.

codes.name: ValidationFailed
codes.title: Validation failed
codes.description: The collection validator refused the document.
codes.hint: The collection's validator refused the document: compare the document with its JSON Schema.

codes.name: RateLimited
codes.title: Rate limited
codes.description: The caller sent too many requests.
codes.hint: Wait for Retry-After (or details.retryAfterSeconds) before sending more.

codes.name: LimitSubscriptions
codes.title: Too many subscriptions
codes.description: The connection holds too many subscriptions.

codes.name: SubscriptionTooLarge
codes.title: Subscription too large
codes.description: A subscription's result is too large.
codes.hint: Give the live query a limit, or narrow its filter.

codes.name: BulkLimit
codes.title: Bulk limit exceeded
codes.description: A bulk request exceeds its limit.

codes.name: CollectionDropped
codes.title: Collection dropped
codes.description: The collection was dropped.

codes.name: SessionMoved
codes.title: Session moved
codes.description: The session lives on another node.

codes.name: ProtocolError
codes.title: Protocol error
codes.description: A frame broke the wire protocol.

codes.name: Timeout
codes.title: Timeout
codes.description: The operation timed out.

codes.name: Unavailable
codes.title: Unavailable
codes.description: A dependency is unavailable.

codes.name: Internal
codes.title: Internal error
codes.description: An unexpected server error.

codes.name: AuthHookFailed
codes.title: Claims hook failed
codes.description: The built in auth claims hook failed; no token was issued.

codes.name: ConfigInvalid
codes.title: Invalid configuration
codes.description: Local only: a configuration that does not validate. Never sent over the wire.
